name: Wazawai no Nihon Ningyou
source:
Mimu started living in an old mansion because of her father.
She found an old Japanese doll in the weird mansion.
Since then, unnatural phenomena began...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE059231.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
因为父亲的缘故，美梦搬进了一栋古老宅邸。
她在这座诡异的宅子里发现了一个陈旧的日本人偶。
从那以后，种种异常现象接连出现……
